item.title: Ame ~The Rain~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Digi Anime
  • 発売日: 2003-08-29
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 雨～The Rain～
  • 英語名: Ame The Rain

あらすじ

Main character is at a loss under the rain when he meets a girl with a healing smile. She invites him to live at her place till it stops to rain, e.g. under the same roof with three cute girls. The weather forecast shows that it’s going to rain for at least a week more.

item.title: Fushigi Densha
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Digi Anime
  • 発売日: 2003-03-28
  • スコア: 6.62/10 (131 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふしぎ電車
  • 英語名: Fushigi Densha

あらすじ

Our protagonist awakens in a bar in front of the station, intoxicated and drunk.

He finds himself in a strange city rife with insanity and bereft of all sense. Yet, he spots a mysterious train rushing to the platform.

In the absence of a great many alternatives, he boards the train and sets out on a journey full of bizarre stories and lots of sexual temptations.

item.title: Tokumei Kachou Ijuuin Ginzaburou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Digi Anime
  • 発売日: 2000-08-18
  • スコア: 5.82/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 特命課長 慰中陰 銀三郎
  • 英語名: Tokumei Kachou Ijuuin Ginzaburou

あらすじ

Japan is devastated by the eruption of Mt. Fuji in 2010. A huge casino is built on the ruins of the city under JCP company. Main character is JCP intelligence agent tasked to prevent hostile companies plotting against JCP. Hero knows special technique from ancient India to make girls fall for him in an instant, and he utilizes it against females of the rival corporations to learn their scheming and secrets.

item.title: Present Play
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Digi Anime
  • 発売日: 1999-06-24
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: プレゼントプレイ
  • 英語名: Present Play

别名

  • 華劇アニメーションAVG

あらすじ

In this game, you pick a costume and an actress, then a story starts. In the beginning, there is only one girl and few costumes. In stories, you can fine two other girls and more costumes. If you make it far enough in a story, you will see an animation of the girl getting rid of her costume.
